rationale: The parties have agreed on the diagnostic frame and a process for comparing scenarios, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and Lower Saxony still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still refuse to rule them out. Positions are now hardened into a stable impasse, yet the proposed plant-level scenario model has not been tested, so further rounds could still clarify whether a no-closure package is economically sufficient.
